scheme.name: Kolefnisgjald on gas and diesel oil

dataset.method: Lög um umhverfis- og auðlindaskatta nr. 129/2009, 1. gr. (kolefnisgjald, the carbon tax on fossil fuel): 13.45 kr. per litre of gas and diesel oil, as amended by L. 100/2023, 1. gr. (in force 2024-01-01), in Alþingi's lagasafn útgáfa 154b (12. apríl 2024). The importer or producer pays it on the fuel it sells and passes it on in the pump price, so a trip pays it where its fuel is bought. Litres are the trip's road fuel as given (diesel_l), or its tank-to-wheel CO2 at 2.67 kg per litre of diesel (EN 16258:2012).

sources.title: Alþingi lagasafn útgáfa 154b (12 April 2024): Lög um umhverfis- og auðlindaskatta nr. 129/2009, the kolefnisgjald per litre of gas and diesel oil (the Internet Archive's copy; althingi.is refuses the workflow)
